io_lines.text: # Construct corrected RAW phase only for the 607 reference points.
# Spatial reference for every epoch is median of same 607 points.
# median of same 607-point reference = 0 each epoch.
# Reference cumulative should be extremely close to zero because

formula.spatial_reference: phi_final = phi_t - median(phi_t[607 reference points], epoch)
